EnumeratedParameterType.name: Tfvn
EnumeratedParameterType.shortDescription: Transfer Frame Version Numbers are 4 bits long CCSDS References add 1 to the binary value when counting versions in english (e.g. TM & TC are "version 1" but 0b00) Until the release of USLP, TFVN were 2 bits long With the addition of USLP two bits were added to the trailing end that serve as the 2 most significant bits (i.e. on the wire USLP sends 0b1100) See section 3.2.2.2 of USLP Overview (CCSDS 700.1-G-1), section 4.1.2.2.2 of AOS (CCSDS 732.0-B-5), section 4.3.2 of Space Data Link Protocol Summary (CCSDS 130.2-G-3), & table 3-1 in Overview of Space Comms Protocols (CCSDS 130.0-G-4)

Enumeration.shortDescription: Anything equal or higher value is invalid and should not be used
Enumeration.label: INVALID_UNINITIALIZED
